component.name: Sayfern
component.summary: Learn a language by chatting with an AI tutor

description.p: Sayfern is a free, open-source app for learning Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian or Vietnamese by chatting with an AI tutor that remembers what you are learning.

ul.li: Bring your own model: an API key, or a Claude or ChatGPT subscription
Corrections, grammar progress and courses, computed on your computer
Quizzes, Anki export and Anki deck generation
Listen to the tutor and talk instead of typing

description.p: All your records stay on your computer as plain files.
